cells.row-2-audit|cs-program:
(define (audit x lo hi)
  (list (clamp x lo hi) (= (clamp x lo hi) x)))
(display (list (audit 5 0 10) (audit 50 0 10) (audit 5 10 0)))
(newline)
cells.row-3-dimension|eng-program:
(define (plain x) (clamp x 0 10))
(define (physical px) (clamp px 0 239))
(define (sprite-row y) (quotient (clamp y 0 239) 8))
(display (list (plain 42) (physical 400) (sprite-row 400)))
(newline)
cells.row-3-dimension|math-program:
(define (plain x) (clamp x -1 1))
(define (physical deg) (clamp deg -90 90))
(define (cosine-domain x) (cos (clamp x -1 1)))
(display (list (plain 8) (physical 270) (cosine-domain 0)))
(newline)
cells.row-3-dimension|cs-program:
(define (plain x) (clamp x 0 255))
(define (physical bits) (clamp bits 0 8))
(define (channel-byte v) (exact (floor (clamp v 0 255))))
(display (list (plain 300) (physical 32) (channel-byte 128.7)))
(newline)
cells.row-4-proof|eng-program:
(define (holds? x lo hi)
  (and (>= (clamp x lo hi) lo) (<= (clamp x lo hi) hi)))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list -5 0 10) (list 5 0 10) (list 15 0 10) (list 0 0 0))))
(newline)
cells.row-4-proof|math-program:
(define (holds? x lo hi)
  (= (clamp (clamp x lo hi) lo hi) (clamp x lo hi)))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list -5 0 10) (list 5 0 10) (list 15 0 10) (list 5 10 0))))
(newline)
cells.row-4-proof|cs-program:
(define (holds? x lo hi)
  (= (clamp x lo hi) (min hi (max lo x))))
(display (map (lambda (c) (apply holds? c))
              (list (list 5 0 10) (list -3 0 10) (list 15 0 10) (list 5 10 0))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|eng-composition:
(define (apply-damage hp dmg)
  (clamp (- hp dmg) 0 100))
(define (fight hp blows)
  (fold (lambda (d h) (apply-damage h d)) hp blows))
(display (list (fight 100 (list 30 30 30)) (fight 100 (list 60 60))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|math-composition:
(define (clamped-lerp a b t)
  (+ a (* (- b a) (clamp t 0 1))))
(define (ease-track a b ts)
  (map (lambda (t) (clamped-lerp a b t)) ts))
(display (list (ease-track 0 100 (list -1 1/2 2)) (ease-track 10 20 (list 0 1))))
(newline)
cells.row-5-emergence|cs-composition:
(define (bounded-add acc x)
  (clamp (+ acc x) -128 127))
(define (saturating-sum xs)
  (fold (lambda (x acc) (bounded-add acc x)) 0 xs))
(display (list (saturating-sum (list 100 100 100)) (saturating-sum (list -100 -100))))
(newline)
